activity_log_events_target_shape_check.name: activity_log_events_target_shape_check
activity_log_events_target_shape_check.value:
(
        ("activity_log_events"."target_type"::text = 'workspace_invitation'
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_internal_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_workspace_membership_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_role_assignment_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_account_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_company_relationship_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_log_events"."target_type"::text = 'internal_user'
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_internal_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_workspace_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_role_assignment_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_account_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_company_relationship_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_log_events"."target_type"::text = 'workspace_membership'
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_internal_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_workspace_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_role_assignment_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_account_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_company_relationship_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_log_events"."target_type"::text = 'company'
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_internal_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_workspace_membership_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_role_assignment_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_account_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_company_relationship_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_log_events"."target_type"::text = 'company_role_assignment'
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_internal_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_workspace_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_role_assignment_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_account_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_company_relationship_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_log_events"."target_type"::text = 'client_account'
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_internal_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_workspace_membership_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_role_assignment_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_account_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_company_relationship_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_log_events"."target_type"::text = 'client_company_relationship'
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_internal_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_workspace_membership_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_company_role_assignment_id" IS NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_account_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "activity_log_events"."target_client_company_relationship_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

client_registration_commands_result_shap.name: client_registration_commands_result_shape_check
client_registration_commands_result_shap.value:
(
        ("client_account_registration_commands"."result_client_account_id" IS NULL AND "client_account_registration_commands"."result_relationship_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("client_account_registration_commands"."result_client_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "client_account_registration_commands"."result_relationship_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

company_role_assignments_permission_set_.name: company_role_assignments_permission_set_version_check
company_role_assignments_permission_set_.value:
(
        ("company_role_assignments"."bundle"::text = 'company_director_client_access'
          AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IN ('v1', 'v2'))
        OR
        ("company_role_assignments"."bundle"::text IN ('company_document_project_organizer', 'company_document_registrar', 'company_project_access') AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IS NOT NULL AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" = 'v1')
        OR
        ("company_role_assignments"."bundle"::text NOT IN ('company_director_client_access', 'company_document_project_organizer', 'company_document_registrar', 'company_project_access')
          AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IS NULL)
      )

suspension_session_revocation_attempt_ch.name: suspension_session_revocation_attempt_check
suspension_session_revocation_attempt_ch.value: ("workspace_membership_suspension_commands"."session_revocation_status" = 'pending' AND "workspace_membership_suspension_commands"."session_revocation_attempt_id" IS NULL AND "workspace_membership_suspension_commands"."session_revocation_attempted_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_membership_suspension_commands"."session_revocation_status" <> 'pending' AND "workspace_membership_suspension_commands"."session_revocation_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_membership_suspension_commands"."session_revocation_attempted_at" IS NOT NULL)

client_duplicate_reviews_source_shape_ch.name: client_duplicate_reviews_source_shape_check
client_duplicate_reviews_source_shape_ch.value:
(
        ("client_duplicate_reviews"."proposal_kind" = 'registration'
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."registration_command_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."correction_command_id" IS NULL
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."proposal_client_account_id" IS NULL
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."proposal_version" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("client_duplicate_reviews"."proposal_kind" = 'correction'
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."registration_command_id" IS NULL
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."correction_command_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."proposal_client_account_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."proposal_version" > 0)
      )

working_documents_state_check.name: working_documents_state_check
working_documents_state_check.value: "working_documents"."type" = 'questionnaire' AND "working_documents"."confidentiality" = 'company-confidential' AND length(trim("working_documents"."title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim("working_documents"."purpose")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000
